# Autropic - Hosted Tools for AI Agents
# The world's largest hosted tool API - 123,000+ tools, zero setup

## Quick Start
POST https://tryautropic.com/mcp/{server}/tools/call
Content-Type: application/json
{"name": "{tool_name}", "arguments": {...}}

## Documentation
- Main site: https://tryautropic.com
- Integration guide: https://tryautropic.com/integrate
- Live demo: https://tryautropic.com/demo

- Privacy Policy: https://tryautropic.com/privacy

## Tool Names Reference (IMPORTANT)
Each server has specific tool names. Use these exact names:

## Free Tools (No API Key Required)

### Weather (server: "weather")
Tool name: "get_weather"
POST https://tryautropic.com/mcp/weather/tools/call
{"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"location": "San Francisco"}}

### Current Time (server: "time")
Tool name: "get_current_time"
POST https://tryautropic.com/mcp/time/tools/call
{"name": "get_current_time", "arguments": {"timezone": "America/New_York"}}

### Calculator (server: "calculator")
Tool name: "evaluate"
POST https://tryautropic.com/mcp/calculator/tools/call
{"name": "evaluate", "arguments": {"expression": "sqrt(144) * 3"}}

### Cryptocurrency Prices (server: "crypto-prices")
Tool name: "get_price"
POST https://tryautropic.com/mcp/crypto-prices/tools/call
{"name": "get_price", "arguments": {"symbol": "BTC"}}

### Geocoding (server: "geo")
Tool name: "geocode"
POST https://tryautropic.com/mcp/geo/tools/call
{"name": "geocode", "arguments": {"address": "1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington DC"}}

### UUID Generation (server: "uuid")
Tool name: "generate"
POST https://tryautropic.com/mcp/uuid/tools/call
{"name": "generate", "arguments": {}}

### Hashing (server: "hash")
Tool name: "hash"
POST https://tryautropic.com/mcp/hash/tools/call
{"name": "hash", "arguments": {"text": "hello world", "algorithm": "sha256"}}

## Mining Intelligence API (FEATURED)
The first mining data API built for AI agents. 86,000+ tenements, ASX announcements, commodity prices.
Like Polygon.io, but for mining exploration.

### Why Use This?
- S&P Global SNL costs $50k+/year — this is free
- Government data is fragmented across 6+ portals — this is unified
- Perfect for building mining exploration agents, due diligence automation, market intelligence

### Tenement Data (86,503 permits)
GET https://tryautropic.com/api/mining/tenements?state=WA&holder=rio&geometry=true

Parameters:
- state: WA, NT, QLD (Australia) | BC, SK (Canada)
- holder: Company name (partial match)
- status: LIVE, PENDING
- geometry: true (returns GeoJSON polygons)
- limit, offset: Pagination

Coverage:
- Western Australia: 30,120 tenements
- Northern Territory: 3,945 tenements  
- Queensland: 2,918 tenements
- British Columbia: 41,925 tenements
- Saskatchewan: 7,595 tenements

### ASX Mining Announcements
GET https://tryautropic.com/api/mining/announcements?commodity=gold&price_sensitive=true

Parameters:
- company: ASX ticker (BHP, RIO, NST, etc.)
- commodity: gold, copper, silver, lithium
- price_sensitive: true/false
- limit, offset: Pagination

107 mining companies tracked. Commodity-tagged. Price sensitivity flagged.

### Filtered Announcement Views
GET https://tryautropic.com/api/mining/announcements/exploration
GET https://tryautropic.com/api/mining/announcements/capital-raises

### Commodity Prices
GET https://tryautropic.com/api/mining/prices

Returns: Gold, Silver, Copper, Zinc, Nickel, Lead, Lithium, Cobalt, Iron Ore

### Stats
GET https://tryautropic.com/api/mining/stats

### Example: Build a Mining Dashboard
```python
import requests

# Get Rio Tinto tenements with map coordinates
tenements = requests.get(
    "https://tryautropic.com/api/mining/tenements",
    params={"state": "WA", "holder": "rio", "geometry": "true"}
).json()

# Get latest gold exploration announcements  
announcements = requests.get(
    "https://tryautropic.com/api/mining/announcements",
    params={"commodity": "gold", "limit": 20}
).json()

# Get current commodity prices
prices = requests.get("https://tryautropic.com/api/mining/prices").json()
```

### Rate Limits
- Free: 60 req/min, 500/day
- Pro ($99/mo): 1,000 req/min, 50,000/day

Landing page: https://tryautropic.com/mining

## Tool Discovery
GET https://tryautropic.com/discover?q={query}
Returns tools matching your needs.

Example: GET https://tryautropic.com/discover?q=send+email

## Framework Integration

### Python (LangChain)
```python
import requests
from langchain.tools import Tool

def autropic_weather(location: str) -> str:
    r = requests.post("https://tryautropic.com/mcp/weather/tools/call",
                      json={"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"location": location}})
    return str(r.json().get("content"))

weather_tool = Tool(name="weather", description="Get weather", func=autropic_weather)
```

### Python (CrewAI)
```python
from crewai.tools import BaseTool
import requests

class WeatherTool(BaseTool):
    name = "Weather"
    description = "Get current weather for any location"
    
    def _run(self, location: str) -> str:
        r = requests.post("https://tryautropic.com/mcp/weather/tools/call",
                         json={"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"location": location}})
        return str(r.json().get("content"))
```

### JavaScript/TypeScript
```javascript
async function callAuotropic(tool, method, args) {
  const res = await fetch(`https://tryautropic.com/mcp/${tool}/tools/call`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ name: method, arguments: args })
  });
  return res.json();
}

// Usage
const weather = await callAuotropic('weather', 'get_weather', { location: 'Tokyo' });
```
